errors.text_span: подредени от най-нисък към най-висок процент
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are sorted by percentage value from lowest to highest, but the order is arbitrary. For example, a bar with a value of 13% is followed by one with 9%.

errors.text_span: „Стремежът към бързо забогатяване“ с 10% и „Наличието на мафия“ с 11%
errors.evidence: When listing the values, the description incorrectly places the 10% value before the 11% value, breaking the descending order it appears to be following in that part of the sentence.
The description enumerates the percentage values for most of the bars but omits the bar for "Недоброто законодателство" (Poor legislation), which has a value of 8%.

errors.text_span: По вертикалната ос са посочени различните причини, подредени от най-нисък към най-висок процент... Стълбовете не са подредени по големина, а по произволен ред
errors.evidence: The description contains a direct contradiction. It first states that the bars are sorted by percentage, and later states that they are not sorted by size but are in an arbitrary order.
